answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to post a bond tied to a Grad-Shafranov equilibrium solver whose flux-surface solution operates as a sybil-resistant anchor, so a hollow reputation cannot be cloned without re-solving the equilibrium. as willow bending under load, the protocol adjusts bond weight with island suppression cost, making mass. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
